actions.name: COMPARE_MAJOR_DETAIL_WEEKS
actions.sideEffect: SELECT only year+major exact01..04/Master customer/product, actual date calendar, each native detail total counted once. Common exact whole bunch/stem display, explicit zero preserved, missing/corrupt/stale results never become a grand total. Sibling detail weeks read-only. Existing canonical date editor/save is selected detail-week only; no aggregate or sibling payload and no financial/stock/estimate writes. The row axis is the common subweek set from ALL products/customers in the same year+major response, identical in every selected subweek. Missing customer/product allocations are readonly display-only zeros, never persisted or counted as real records. Dates are shared once per table column, not repeated per body row. Only selected actual positive allocations have editor controls.
